look_here_first: Start at the perennial basal rosette and nearly leafless flowering scapes. Because local T. scaposa can look very similar, confirm the taxonomic concept and provenance instead of identifying a scaped yellow daisy as acaulis by color.

key_traits.label: Best field traits
key_traits.text: Perennial basal crown and rosette.; Leaves concentrated at the base; flowering stalks mostly leafless.; One yellow radiate head per scape.; Reviewed var. acaulis is Panhandle/Great Plains-centered; identity must not be inferred from a generic Central Texas four-nerve daisy.

lookalikes.differences: T. linearifolia is an annual with leafy flowering stems. T. scaposa var. scaposa is the documented local perennial rosette-and-scape four-nerve daisy; T. acaulis overlaps morphologically, so use verified species/variety and geography rather than color alone.
